title: Bounded transfers
objective: Enforce bounded downloads into protected staging with validated destinations, type, size, digest, origin and redirect policy, approval, create-only writes, reparse-safe handling, and no automatic open, execute, or extraction; and bounded uploads from server-recorded sources only with exact digest, size, media type, file-input identity, workspace and trust binding, approval, and one-shot consumption with no arbitrary caller path. Prove traversal, UNC, device, ADS, reserved-name, junction, symlink, reparse, changed-source, duplicate, replay, and crash-cleanup behavior.

include: download staging protection, destination validation, type validation, size bound, digest, origin and redirect policy
download approval, create-only destination, reparse-safe path handling, no automatic open, execute, or extraction
upload server-recorded source only with exact digest, size, media type, and file-input identity
upload workspace and trust binding, approval, one-shot consumption, no arbitrary caller path
traversal, UNC, device, ADS, reserved-name, junction, symlink, reparse, changed-source, duplicate, replay, and crash-cleanup tests
exclude: automatic file opening, execution, or extraction
new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority

authority_delta.filesystem: Create-only writes inside the approved workspace transfer root owned by Deskal. No overwrite, rename, delete, or truncate.
authority_delta.process: None beyond the SG-000074 Deskal-supervised low-authority browser child process family.
authority_delta.network: None beyond SG-000075 governed navigation decisions for the isolated host.
authority_delta.browser: Bounded transfer staging only. No execution, opening, or extraction of transferred content.
authority_delta.secrets: None. Transfer content digests only; no secret material in records.
authority_delta.approval: None. Transfers consume existing fresh approvals; no approval minting.

invariants: transferred content is never executed, opened, or extracted
no caller path ever reaches the filesystem
changed or replayed sources fail closed

acceptance.claim: Downloads enforce staging, destination, type, size, digest, origin policy, approval, create-only writes, and reparse safety with no automatic handling, proven by attack tests.
Uploads enforce server-recorded sources with exact digest, size, media type, file-input identity, workspace and trust binding, approval, and one-shot consumption with no caller path.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000079: SG-000079 may activate only after SG-000078 closes canonically with bounded transfers as its base.

done_when: Bounded downloads and uploads exist with staging, validation, approval, and one-shot semantics and no automatic handling, proven by attack tests.
